caption: The drawing depicts a metal stove, colored in shades of brown and bronze. The stove has an oval, vertically oriented body with decorative floral and fan patterns embossed on its side panels. It stands on four ornate, curved legs that elevate it above the ground. There is a prominent, rectangular opening on the front side, and an extended flat surface or shelf protrudes from the left side of the stove. On this extended surface are a pair of black metal tongs and what appears to be a flat tool, possibly a shovel or poker, also in a dark color. The background is plain and off-white, with no other objects besides the stove and its attached tools. The name "John Bodine" is printed in light gray text at the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Tailor's Stove
